# citecheck

> Deterministic RAG citation verifier for Python 3.11+. Catches empty answers, unknown source IDs, ungrounded quotes, high-specificity uncited claims, and unused sources—stdlib only, no LLM calls.

Use as a library (`from citecheck import verify`) or CLI (`citecheck <input.json> [--strict] [--json]`). Also supports `--stdin`. Exit codes: `0` (pass), `1` (error findings), `2` (runtime/config error). Version: `0.1.0`.

## Documentation
- [README.md](README.md): 60-second quickstart, CLI + Python usage, rules and exit codes.
- [SPEC.md](SPEC.md): Exact v0.1.0 input contract, 5 rules, CLI flags, exit codes, and JSON schema.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Contributing-agent architecture boundaries and `make check` verification gate.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT license.
